meta.title: 遇见楼梯一定要试试这样拍🎬氛围感十足
meta.title_en: Try These Poses When You Meet a Staircase
meta.topic: 楼梯拍照 · 机位与构图技巧

scenes.context: 朋友蹲下低机位平拍最容易翻车，由此引出四个楼梯拍照技巧。
sentences: 当朋友蹲下的时候，就知道要翻车了。
When my friend crouches down, I know it's going to flop.
flop（翻车/失败）
分享四个楼梯拍照小技巧。
Here are four staircase photo tricks.
trick（小技巧）
paraphrase: The shot is doomed to fail.
scenes.speak: When my friend crouches down, I know it's going to flop. Here are four staircase photo tricks.

scenes.context: 手机抬高、后退两步、切换 1.5 倍，人物放中下两格，拍出楼梯纵深。
sentences: 你先把手机抬高。
Raise your phone first.
raise（抬高）
再后退两步，切换1.5倍。
Step back twice and switch to 1.5x zoom.
step back（后退）
把我放在中下两格就可以拍了。
Place me in the middle-lower two cells and shoot.
middle-lower（中下）
paraphrase: The stairs stretch away into depth.
Use the stair lines to lead the eye.
scenes.speak: Raise your phone first. Step back twice and switch to 1.5x zoom. Place me in the middle-lower two cells and shoot.

scenes.context: 走到楼梯上面放大两倍俯拍裙摆；侧前方低机位、人物站三分线直接出片。
sentences: 走到上面去，放大两倍。
Go up the stairs and zoom in to 2x.
zoom in（放大）
用俯拍视角拍我站动裙摆。
Shoot me top-down as the skirt moves.
top-down（俯拍）
人物站三分线，出片。
Place me on the rule-of-thirds line and you're done.
rule of thirds（三分线）
paraphrase: It looks more cinematic and poetic.
scenes.speak: Go up the stairs and zoom in to 2x. Shoot me top-down as the skirt moves. Place me on the rule-of-thirds line and you're done.

scenes.context: 侧面抬高手机两倍、手往后撑，与楼梯形成三角形构图，避免显腿短。
sentences: 走到我侧面，把手机抬高一点。
Move to my side and raise the phone a bit.
move to the side（走到侧面）
切换两倍，手往后撑。
Switch to 2x, and push your hand back.
push your hand back（手往后撑）
三角形构图拍一张。
Compose a triangle and take the shot.
triangle composition（三角形构图）
paraphrase: It makes the legs look short.
The arm and stairs form a triangle shape.
scenes.speak: Move to my side and raise the phone a bit. Switch to 2x, and push your hand back. Compose a triangle and take the shot.

practice: 如何拍出楼梯的纵深感？
Raise the phone, step back, and shoot at 1.5x.
It adds a dynamic, cinematic feel.
人物在画面哪里最出片？
Place the subject on the rule-of-thirds line.
Shoot from the side at a raised angle, not head-on and low.
pitfalls: Crouch low for a flat shot.
Raise the phone and shoot from a new angle.
Low flat shots usually flop and shorten the legs.
Heavy digital zoom hurts image quality in low light.
Follow the middle-lower two cells or the thirds line.
Deliberate placement makes the composition work.
Turn to the side and avoid the lens.
A side stance plus hand-back pose creates a triangle structure.
shifts: 现在抬高手机拍纵深感
以前一个机位拍完就走
现在俯拍、低机位、侧面多角度各拍一式
现在用中下两格、三分线、三角形等具体规则
